items.text: while anything in the tools is animating (a word sequence, a steer loop, a magnet loop) a ring keeps rippling out of the tools button; inside, the running chain marks which one, now also under the text shelf's sequence clock
in the tools drawer, a tool that is driving the animation right now (a word sequence, a steer loop, a magnet loop) has a running chain of dots under it, so you can see which one it is
on a phone the opening duck could come down twice. It now waits for the type to arrive and follows the cover's duck all the way, so it lands once, exactly where the duck is
Founders Club is written as a name everywhere: the cover, the sheet, the index and the messages
the sound and color panels' tabs come from the shared kit now, with the same icon-only threshold everywhere
report a bug names a person to write to, hi@chamy.xyz, for anyone who would rather send an email
smaller icons draw thinner lines (one scale from 1 px at 12-17 px up to the bar's 1.9 px), so the index's section icons, tabs, pins and arrows read cleaner beside the text

report a bug. On a computer, the bug in the lower left; on any device, Settings › report a bug. Say what happened; Current adds what it knows about the moment (version, browser, what was playing, recent errors), shown before you send
if the sound ever has to restart itself, Current offers to report it
on a computer the index's pin sits at the right end of the index's icon row, over the move handles; the top bar is for the duck and the namemark only
